title: TriageCase
description: A debugging/triage investigation recorded as a two-tier constraint problem: immutable facts (bottom tier) and hypotheses (top tier). A hypothesis is valid only if consistent with every fact. See README.md.

variable.description: The broken case where the bug shows up.

control.description: The comparison case; identical to the variable except for the suspected cause. A sad path that fails differently is a valid control.

observation.description: What was measured or read, stated exactly.

seen_in.description: variable = high-fidelity signal (in the broken case, absent from the control); both = noise (elimination only); control = recorded for completeness.

provenance.description: How the fact was gathered. The first thing to re-verify when evidence seems to contradict itself.

source.description: log, telemetry, packet capture, heap profile, kernel table, config, git history, user report...

text.description: The mechanism proposed as cause. Combine complementary causes as one hypothesis entry only while each remains strictly necessary.

consistent_with.description: Fact ids this hypothesis does not contradict. Every fact NOT listed counts as contradicted. A candidate is consistent with all facts.

combined_from.description: Optional: hypothesis ids this entry combines. Removing any must leave some fact unexplained.

citations.description: Every claim in the verdict points at a fact id from the factual tier. Unbacked claims are dropped, not padded.

repro_parity.description: Did a reproduction emit the same high-fidelity signal as the report? diverged = the repro is a different bug and is noise.
